title: Konjugate Robotics Toolbox
description: Draw a robot from solids and joints in a 3D window and build it into the canvas: each solid becomes a node and each joint an edge carrying its own equations. The robot then runs, takes live sliders, forks and fits like any other model, and can be wired to anything else you model.

screenshots.caption: An arm with a two-finger gripper drawn from solids and joints, its wrist's servo, limits and damping open beside it
